quotes.quote: Similar patterns in randomly generated graphs were reviewed from fixed graphs generated for the experiment. The generated graphs were recorded online for public access. • Four random graph generation algorithms with example graph binary files ( https://zenodo.org/record/6547767 ).

Lastly, the minimal data set is uploaded to an online data repository for public access. • Common Knowledge Processing Patterns in Networks of Different Systems Minimal Data Set ( https://zenodo.org/record/8122402 ).

G3.rationale: The deposit includes example graph binary files and a minimal data set, which are the analysis inputs (graphs) for computing the measures, not the output tables.

required_files: Common Knowledge Processing Patterns in Networks of Different Systems Minimal Data Set.7z
specification.input_notes: The pickle files are example graph binary files for random graph generation algorithms (Zenodo 6547767). The minimal data set (Zenodo 8122402) likely contains the worm and fruit fly connectome data and generated graphs. The MAG_journals.7z (Zenodo 6547761) is for topic networks, not needed for Table 2. The worm connectome is from Wormatlas (outdated) and fruit fly from hemibrain; these may be included in the minimal data set.

specification.comparison_metric: Compare the reported graph measures (avg_degree, avg_pagerank, avg_clustering, avg_triangles) for worm, fruit fly, and generated graphs to values recomputed from the deposited graph data.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Counts exact; scalars within displayed rounding bin (e.g., 4 decimal places for avg_degree, 4 decimal places for avg_pagerank, 4 decimal places for avg_clustering, 4 decimal places for avg_triangles).
specification.specification_gaps: The exact random seed or generation procedure for the Erdős-Rényi graphs is not specified; the handling of duplicate synapses and directionality in connectome data is described but not fully detailed; the exact version of the connectome data used is not specified.

alternatives_considered.reason: It is a qualitative summary of trends (up/down) without numeric values, so not a quantitative target.
